blocks.text: RIYADH, Saudi Arabia — Saul “Canelo” Alvarez produced a convincing performance to defeat French fighter Christian Mbilli and regain his WBC super middleweight title in an emotional victory in Saudi Arabia on Saturday. The 36-year-old Mexican won a 12-round decision in Riyadh after exerting his influence in the second half of a fight that went ahead […]...
